title: Local SEO: What is it & how to do it
summary: Local SEO is the process of improving search visibility, traffic, and brand awareness for local businesses.
body_markdown:
## Start building your local visibility


A strong Google Business Profile is your first step toward increased local visibility.


Using your free GBP Optimizer is the fastest way to find issues with your Google Business Profile so you can fix them before they impact your rankings.


### Download your free GBP Optimizer


The GBP Optimizer works inside your favorite AI system.


After you upload the tool file (which we’ll provide), it will ask you some questions about your GBP profile and then give you personalized tips for improving it.


### How to use your GBP Optimizer


**For use in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot:** Download the lite-prompt.md file. Upload it to your favorite AI assistant.


Answer the tool’s questions about your GBP.


**For use in Claude Code or Codex:** Download the .zip file, open it, and add the new folder to your AI assistant.


Answer the prompts so the tool has the right information to analyze.


If your assistant asks a question before running, just answer it — that's normal, and it'll pick right back up.


Whichever method you choose, you’ll get a grade for your GBP along with a personal and prioritized checklist of items to improve.
